request: AI Core PR3 exact-head full unittest suite in temporary isolated source with cleanup

bounded_host_request.command:
python3 -c 'import subprocess,tarfile,io,tempfile,pathlib,os,sys
s="62861bfa96de87b5320f554097e799438654875b"
b=subprocess.check_output(["gh","api","repos/seigo-gace/ai-core/tarball/"+s],timeout=25)
if len(b)>4000000: raise ValueError("ARCHIVE_TOO_LARGE")
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="ai-core-exact-tests-") as tmp:
 t=tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(b),mode="r:gz")
 for m in t:
  q=pathlib.PurePosixPath(m.name).parts[1:]
  if not m.isfile() or not q or ".." in q:continue
  p=pathlib.Path(tmp).joinpath(*q);p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);p.write_bytes(t.extractfile(m).read())
 env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONPATH=tmp)
 z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-m","unittest","discover","-s","tests","-p","test_*.py"],cwd=tmp,env=env,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=85)
 print(z.stdout[-1800:]);print(z.stderr[-3500:])
 print("AI_CORE_EXACT_SHA="+s+" EXIT="+str(z.returncode))
 sys.exit(z.returncode)'
